A.why: says what it is: the text as printed, with no repair

C.meaning: the definitions as printed with Russell's ✱8·13 (1925) carried over to ✱9; the working reading
C.why: names whose repair it is, as landini does; the authors' own fix, so the author's name

L.meaning: Landini's ✱9+ (2000): ✱9·yy, ✱9·zz and the rule Switch; a published variant kept as a cross-check
L.why: names whose repair it is; the Lean name withSwitch names a mechanism, and Switch alone would not say whose

B.meaning: an alternative convention of this project's, kept as a cross-check
B.why: the word the repository already uses (Reading.convention, docs/REPAIRS.md); it says this is a convention, not PM's text or anyone's published repair

P.meaning: the definitions as printed with this project's prenex Switch (R5), kept for comparison
P.why: names the mechanism, which is this project's own construction and has no author to name
